correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed all 2^18 subsets of the coordinatewise-inequality K2 x K3 x K3 graph, giving 18 vertices, 36 edges and 108 minimal forbidden induced-degree-two triples. Both face predicates yield 8564 nonempty faces; pivot-matched cover pairs total 4273; remaining critical cells one zero-cell and 17 five-cells. Constructed all 42786 Hasse incidences with matched edges directed upward and all others downward and topologically sorted all 8564 face nodes: complete acyclicity, not a partial sample. Forman discrete Morse theory then gives a CW complex with 1 zero-cell and 17 five-cells, with trivial attaching maps for dimensional reasons, hence an integral wedge of 17 S5. Direct mod-two rank code in source provides only corroboration. No claim outside this finite graph/filtration level.
